name: Iheya (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Iheya village emblem in green: a winged device above a ring enclosing a stylised sprout.
history: Municipal flag of Iheya, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field.

features.role: Iheya village emblem — a winged device above a ring enclosing a stylised sprout
